title: Shaping ARIRANG: The Vision Behind the Music and the Stage
story:
SHAPING THE SOUND OF ARIRANG

When BTS began creating their ARIRANG album, j-hope was not simply preparing to perform the new songs. He was actively involved in shaping the music and imagining how it would come alive on stage.

His contribution to the album is significant: **j-hope is credited as a songwriter on 10 of its 14 tracks**. These include **Body to Body, Hooligan, Aliens, 2.0, Merry Go Round, NORMAL, they don’t know ’bout us, One More Night, Please, and Into the Sun**. His involvement shows just how much he contributed to the musical identity of this new chapter in BTS’ story.

STANDING UP FOR ARIRANG

One of the most memorable creative discussions centered on **Body to Body**. j-hope and Jimin supported including a sample of the traditional Korean folk song **Arirang**, while RM and SUGA initially opposed the idea. j-hope stood by his belief that international listeners would find the combination exciting, and he eventually helped convince the others to embrace it.

Today, that very moment has become one of the highlights of the **ARIRANG tour**. Fans around the world eagerly wait for the Arirang section so they can sing along with BTS. At some concerts, ARMY have even raised South Korean flags while singing the traditional melody together with the members.

A NEW WAY TO EXPERIENCE THE STAGE

j-hope's vision also reached beyond the music. **The 360-degree stage used for the ARIRANG tour was his idea**. After looking back at BTS' previous concerts, he realized that they had never performed with the audience surrounding them from every direction. He suggested changing that for the new tour, and the members supported the idea.

Making it work meant rethinking the performance. With no single front to face, the members had to adapt their movements and choreography to an audience surrounding them from every angle. It was a new challenge, but also a new way to connect with ARMY throughout the stadium.

FROM THE MUSIC TO THE STAGE

From contributing to ten songs on the album, to standing up for the inclusion of Arirang in Body to Body, to imagining a stage that brings the audience into the heart of the performance, **j-hope helped shape some of the defining elements of the ARIRANG era**. He was not only preparing to stand on that stage. He was helping imagine what the music and the experience could become.
surpriseDescription: Remember this moment from the making of “Body to Body”? Watch j-hope excitedly introduce the Arirang sample to RM and SUGA - a musical idea that would become one of the most memorable moments of the ARIRANG era. And then see how that moment comes full circle: international ARMY raising Korean flags and singing Arirang together with BTS, turning j-hope's idea into an unforgettable celebration of music, culture and connection.
